entities.name: Odd Acorn Gang
entities.description: A legendary group of squirrelfolk warriors from Bloomburrow who work for Hazel.

entities.name: Hazel
entities.description: A cachemaster who calls in favors from the Odd Acorn Gang.

entities.name: Rosemary
entities.description: Burly, brawny squirrelfolk member of the gang whose fists do the talking.

entities.name: Oregano
entities.description: Smarmy, sneaky squirrelfolk member who pulls pranks on friends.

entities.name: Thyme
entities.description: Silent, stylish squirrelfolk archer of the gang.

relations.quote: the burly and brawny Rosemary , whose fists do the talking for her
the smarmy and sneaky Oregano , who can't help but pull pranks on their friends
the silent and stylish Thyme , whose bow makes quick work of her enemies

relations.note: Hazel calls in a favor when she needs something done.
relations.quote: When cachemaster Hazel needs something done, she'll call in a favor.
